proposed_cards.title: Fix 6 missing alt texts on dealer-sourced vehicle images
proposed_cards.evidence: [onpage.json#images] — VIN-based dealer-hosted URLs (jywofirdogvecsftznfe.supabase.co) have empty alt=""; affects Vehicle/Offer JSON-LD alt propagation and accessibility audit. Likely caused by blank VDP enrichment fields.
proposed_cards.body:
**Problem:** 6 of 12 vehicle images sourced from DealerOn (supabase CDN) have empty alt attributes.

**VINs with missing alts:**
- `1GNEVGKW9PJ178289`
- `3GNAXWEX9JS508056`
- `3GNAXKEG4RL116830`
- `4T1F31AK0PU050516`
- `1FTPX125X5FB10521`
- `3GNAXUEG1PL229238`

**Impact:** Vehicle JSON-LD Offer `image.alt` will be empty; ADA compliance gap.

**Resolution:** Wire VDP spec/data fields (make, model, year) into image alt text. The same enrichment sync referenced in MOT-2441 should populate these alts.

proposed_cards.title: llms.txt: Add `- [Title](url)` page links for format validation
proposed_cards.evidence: [llmstxt.json#issues] — 0 links found; tool reports 'No page links found (use "- [Page Title](url): Description")'. 23 Key pages exist but none are linked in the file.
proposed_cards.body:
**Problem:** llms.txt passes `has_title`, `has_description`, and `has_sections` checks but fails format validation because all page references use bullet (`-`) without `- [Title](url): Description` syntax, resulting in 0 recognized links.

**Resolution:** Update llms.txt to use the `- [Page Title](url): Short description` format per the llms-spec (see https://llms-txt.org) for each of the 23 key pages and their sub-pages. Verify post-change with `format_valid: true`.

proposed_cards.title: Staging cutover checklist: remove noindex/self-canonicalize all pages
proposed_cards.evidence: [technical.json#meta_tags.robots] noindex,nofollow present; [technical.json#canonical] cross-host to staging.motorinnautogroup.com; [crawlers.json#sitemaps] sitemap points to www.motorinnautogroup.com
proposed_cards.body:
**Pre-cutover gating items** (all expected on staging, action required at cutover):

1. Remove `robots=noindex,nofollow` from every page [technical.json#meta_tags.robots]
2. Replace cross-host canonicals (`staging.motorinnautogroup.com`) with self-referencing canonicals on the live domain (motorinnautogroup.com)
3. Ensure robots.txt Sitemap tag points to `https://www.motorinnautogroup.com/sitemap.xml` (already correct per [crawlers.json#sitemaps])
4. Verify no .vercel.app URLs remain indexable in production.
